title: Hello Main Street
intro: Good morning! Smell that? Fresh bread, right out of the oven. Now my bakery just needs a sign.
Could you put my shop's name, “Rosa's Bakery”, on top, and “Fresh bread daily” underneath?
My sketch is up on the sign board. Press Run whenever you want me to take a look!
celebration: Oh! Look at that, it's beautiful!
thanks: That's my sign! Now everyone will know where the bread is.
request: Could you make me a sign? Put my shop's name, "Rosa's Bakery", on top, and "Fresh bread daily" underneath.

criteria.description: The text "Rosa's Bakery" is on screen
criteria.message: I don't see my shop's name yet.
I'd like my name on top, please!
